issue_description: Discrepancy between full raster domain (1888722 cells) and study AOI domain (993736 cells)
root_cause: Backend Phase 8.4 reported full raster extent whereas scientific Phase 5 bound products to Study AOI
reconciliation_action: Reconciled common valid domain to 993736 cells (397.49 km2) and persistent non-water to 628515 cells (251.41 km2); enforced closed accounting identities

issue_description: Divergence in lateral displacement statistics and omission of explicit medians
root_cause: Response lacked explicit median values and clarification that statistics apply strictly to 122 valid local migration transects
reconciliation_action: Reconciled empirical stats from 122 valid rows (West mean=130m/med=40m; East mean=160.66m/med=90m; Width mean=290.66m/med=180m); confirmed 95% spatial bootstrap intervals

issue_description: Tree-path attribution additivity residual error up to 0.0093
root_cause: Node traversal used float64 while tree split thresholds evaluated at float32 during inference causing boundary path divergence
reconciliation_action: Enforced float32 inference representation across node traversal dropping max residual to 1.15e-07; added support for ensemble_root and background baselines

issue_description: Flood classification tiles rendered outside Jamuna Study AOI
root_cause: GDAL Warp rendered raw raster bounding box (1957165 cells) without cutline clipping to the study area boundary
reconciliation_action: Integrated GDAL /vsimem/study_area_aoi.geojson cutline masking in render_tile setting all pixels outside the Study AOI to 100% transparent (dstNodata=255.0)

issue_description: Terminology discrepancies (Lee 7x7 vs 5x5; 100m vs 200m transects; peak crest vs flood observation; async vs synchronous; SHAP vs Saabas)
root_cause: Outdated narrative descriptions retained from preliminary proposals prior to algorithmic implementation
reconciliation_action: Updated README.md and documentation to reflect Lee 5x5; 200m transects; mid-monsoon flood observation; synchronous execution; and Saabas-style pure-NumPy tree attribution

issue_description: Ambiguity regarding RF architecture (40 trees vs 100) and held-out test metrics
root_cause: Reviewer assumed default sklearn RF rather than pure-NumPy 40-tree max-depth 6 implementation
reconciliation_action: Reconciled 40-tree architecture; verified held-out test metrics (AUC 0.6810; Recall 0.9214; Precision 0.4477); reaffirmed status as auxiliary probability layer

root_cause: Runtime database backups created during maintenance were present in untracked workspace
